publications.title: SpikingLM: Towards Fully Spiking Language Model
publications.authors: Yu Liang, Zijian Zhou, Wenjie Wei, Shuai Wang, Honglin Cao, Ammar Belatreche, Yu Yang, Malu Zhang, Yang Yang, Haizhou Li
publications.imageAlt: SpikingLM architecture with Distribution-aware Scaling and Spike2Max attention
publications.description: Distribution-aware Scaling and Spike2Max attention enable fully spiking language models with stable training and energy-efficient language understanding.

publications.title: Towards Accurate Binary Spiking Neural Networks: Learning with Adaptive Gradient Modulation Mechanism
publications.authors: Yu Liang, Wenjie Wei, Ammar Belatreche, Honglin Cao, Zijian Zhou, Shuai Wang, Malu Zhang, Yang Yang
publications.imageAlt: Network architecture and backpropagation of Adaptive Gradient Modulation Mechanism
publications.description: Adaptive gradient modulation reduces weight sign flipping to improve convergence and accuracy in binary spiking neural networks.

publications.title: BSO: Binary Spiking Online Optimization Algorithm
publications.authors: Yu Liang, Yu Yang, Wenjie Wei, Ammar Belatreche, Shuai Wang, Malu Zhang, Yang Yang
publications.imageAlt: Binary weight update strategies in BSO and temporal-aware T-BSO
publications.description: Direct binary weight updates reduce training memory; a temporal-aware variant adapts update thresholds using gradient information across time steps.
